text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, I went to the library
and found Tanino Gimlet reading a thick book.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Is the Yahiro Wani a shark, a crocodile... or perhaps even a ship?
To think similar myths exist all across the world.
Ancient tales truly are fascinating...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: These tales all share a common karmic sin... Hm?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's see...?
Greek mythology, Roman mythology, Egyptian mythology...
Whoa... there are so many of them...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Naturally. There are as many myths as there are worlds.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hyaaah!
G-G-G-Gimlet-san...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Oho, did I startle you, my Blue Rose?
As an apology, if there is something you are searching for, allow me to assist.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really...!? Are you sure?
For someone like Rice...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, the truth is, Rice has been looking for a word with a pretty, wonderful meaning...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The main character of a picture book... Ah, n-no, that's not it!
Um... I wanted to name the cat I meet in the park...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
She's kind, fluffy, and has a bit of a mysterious power.
So I thought a mythology theme might suit her...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Then why not borrow the name of a goddess?
I'll pick out some reference material for you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Goddess of the Moon... Goddess of Cherry Blossoms...
The spring goddesses presiding over beauty and grace...
Something like that. You should look up their legends.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, each and every one is wonderful...!
Th-Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Scientia est potentia—
"Knowledge is power"... indeed.
Now then, let us continue with the myth...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Were you in the middle of reading this?
My apologies.
It was left out on the desk, so I couldn't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, it's my fault for leaving it out.
Heh heh... Are you interested in Japanese mythology as well?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe stories of gods older than recorded history
offer us a glimpse into the very roots of this nation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: It was a story I simply had to read, so I thought I'd do my best with a classical dictionary in hand.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Impressive.
However, there is an order to all things.
Disorderly learning is meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: "This book is ancient in both era and notation. It would be easier to understand if you trace the broader narrative through an abridged translation first."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Like the one over there...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My, something like this...!
I was certain I would have to consult the original text.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for teaching me♪
In that case, I'll borrow this one for today.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh...
By the time your journey with that book comes to an end,
I too shall have bid farewell to the one from before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Witnessing the undeniable truth lying behind Tanino Gimlet's sharp words and actions, I couldn't just sit still anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, it's you.
What's the matter, looking like a lost little lamb...?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh my, were you watching?
Heh heh heh... It seems you possess the Evil Eye as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was just watching normally from the shadows, but...
I honestly told her that I thought she looked "cool."
choice_data_list: I'd love to sit down and listen to a proper explanation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was just watching normally from the shadows, but...
I honestly told her that I thought she looked "cool."
choice_data_list: I'd love to sit down and listen to a proper explanation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That was nothing.
If one stockpiles intellect on a daily basis,
the fountain of knowledge will flow freely at any time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Brushing it off as if it were nothing at all,
she made a cool exit...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ho, you seek knowledge as well?
If so, you should have just said so sooner...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Shall I give you an open-air lecture on the rooftop?
What is it you wish to know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nothing I wanted to know... immediately came to mind.
Seeing this, she said, "Then I shall tell a tale to your liking,"
and improvised a fascinating story for me.
